name: seo-audit-console
description: The complete technical SEO audit at conversation speed: Google Search Console history + a first-party crawl + on-demand DataForSEO, merged into one prioritised audit inside Claude - 90 checks ranked by recoverable clicks, with paste-ready fixes, keyword and content-gap research, and AI-search readiness.
long_description: Merges Google Search Console history with a first-party site crawl (and on-demand DataForSEO) into one SQLite database per property, then runs ~90 deterministic and judgement-labelled checks scored by expected recoverable clicks per hour of effort. Includes a findings dashboard, finding-to-fix generators (JSON-LD, 301 maps, internal-link suggestions), change detection, keyword and content-gap research, and an agent-readiness score. Requires a Google Cloud service account with Search Console API access; DataForSEO credentials are optional.

google_application_credentials.title: Google service-account JSON key
google_application_credentials.description: Path to the Google Cloud service-account JSON key file with Search Console API access (the account must be added as a user on each GSC property).

sac_data_dir.title: Data directory
sac_data_dir.description: Where the per-property SQLite databases are stored. Leave empty for the default (~/Documents/seo-audit-console).

dataforseo_username.title: DataForSEO username (optional)
dataforseo_username.description: DataForSEO API login. Optional - keyword, rank, backlink, and Labs tools degrade gracefully without it.

dataforseo_cache_days.title: DataForSEO cache days
dataforseo_cache_days.description: How many days to cache DataForSEO responses locally.
